newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX to list revised fuel oil contract in April.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX to list revised fuel oil contract in April.

text.p: The Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) is to list a revised fuel oil futures contract from April 22, an official said on Tuesday.
The official said a statement from SIMEX would be issued later on Tuesday. The official declined to be named.
The existing fuel contract has effectively been untraded since August 1995 because traders said the specifications of the contract were out of line with cash market.
The fuel oil contract was first listed in 1989.
Sources close to SIMEX said on Monday that the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) has granted approval for the revisions to the contract.

The revisions include physical delivery of 3.5 percent sulphur fuel oil in line with the cargo market, the sources said. Previously the contract had specified delivery of 4.0-percent sulphur fuel oil. In addition, the time window for loading fuel oil delivered against a contract has been narrowed after earlier criticisms that buyers did not have large enough say in the delivery mechanism.
